# OpenAPI validation fixture

`openapi-3.1-schema.json` is the official OpenAPI 3.1 document schema, revision
2025-09-15, downloaded from
<https://spec.openapis.org/oas/3.1/schema/2025-09-15>.

The OpenAPI Initiative publishes the specification and its schemas under the
Apache License 2.0: <https://github.com/OAI/OpenAPI-Specification/blob/main/LICENSE>.
A copy is included as `LICENSE-OpenAPI`.
The fixture is kept locally so contract validation never depends on external
schema services. Its identifier remains intact for attribution and reference
resolution.
